ada.en: there is/are; to exist, to have

bening.en: clear (of liquid; sayur bening = clear vegetable soup)

berbunyi.en: to ring, to make a sound

berkecil.en: berkecil hati = to feel discouraged (ber- + kecil)

betah.en: to feel at home, happy to stay

diganti.en: to be changed, be replaced (di- + ganti)

duanya.en: tidak ada duanya = has no equal (dua + -nya)

it.en: IT, the tech department (English initialism, said ai-ti)

jangan-jangan.en: what if, I'm afraid that (voices a worry)

ketinggalan.en: to get left behind; to miss (a train)

maupun.en: baik A maupun B = both A and B

menengok.en: to visit, look in on someone

mengejar.en: to chase (mengejar tenggat = race a deadline)

mengerjakan.en: to work on, to do (a task)

menurut.en: according to; in the opinion of

mundur.en: to move back; pushed later (of a meeting)

naik.en: to ride, to board, to go up

oleh.en: by (marks the doer of a passive)

pengertian.en: understanding (mohon pengertian = we ask your understanding)

perantauan.en: life away from one's hometown (di perantauan)

pulang.en: to go home, to return home

pura-pura.en: pretending, in pretense (pura-pura sibuk = pretending to be busy)

saji.en: to serve food (root; cepat saji = fast food)

sehingga.en: so that, with the result that

sekalian.en: all of you (Bapak dan Ibu sekalian); at the same time

semakin.en: increasingly; semakin X semakin Y = the more X the more Y

sempat.en: to have the chance or time

terlanjur.en: already done, too late to undo

ternyata.en: it turns out, as it turns out

terpaksa.en: forced to, having no choice (ter- + paksa)

turun.en: to get off, to go down

ucapan.en: wishes, greeting (ucapan ulang tahun = birthday wishes)

ujung.en: end, tip: ujung jalan = end of the street
